title:
Comment of Desiree Cairnduff in Docket(s)/Project(s) P-15423-000
Submission Date: 11/2/2026

documents.name: 152191.txt
documents.text:
Desiree Cairnduff, Eagle River, AK.
As an Alaskan, I strongly oppose the proposed DeepGreen data center in Cook Inlet (Docket P-15423-000). We cannot stand by while a project with potentially serious environmental consequences threatens the waters, wildlife, and fisheries that are so important to our state.

Cook Inlet is home to endangered beluga whales and vital salmon populations. The potential impacts of waste heat, underwater noise, and habitat disruption are deeply concerning. These ecosystems are part of what makes Alaska special, and protecting them should be a priority.

I urge FERC to reject this proposal. Alaska's natural resources and the communities that depend on them deserve protection.
